contract: Pure rule of the recipe version and the tool sources that one Run keeps: the pin captures a package identity and the id, kind and callable of each source at Run start, an explicit change-version input is the only input that changes the version, a published version, a settings change and a listing change nothing, a listing of an outside source is refused, and no input adds a source. No I/O, clock, process, storage or version check.
limits: The pin does not check that a version exists, is checked or is published, and it verifies no operator; the host gives a change-version input only for an authorised, recorded action.
It captures no tool list: the tool list of a known source may change during the Run, and a refusal of a source list by workflow/tool-registry is reported as invalid_input without its reason.
Selected Cure laws cover the supplied input classes only; operand checks (identity form, source ID form, membership), source validation and the host Needs are finite-test grounded or assumed.
No Telemetry, Config or Control; no store, no pointer to a published version and no tenant settings: state/recipe-store and the host own them.

grounding.claim: For every version and offered identity, a published input leaves the pinned version unchanged; the class is supplied by Elixir.
For every version, offered identity and input class other than the explicit change to another identity, the version after the step equals the version before; the class is supplied by Elixir.
For every source list, offered source and input class, the source list after the step equals the list before; the class is supplied by Elixir.

Pinned Cure checks types and totality of the decision table and of the next-version and next-sources functions; the source audit reports no axiom, hole, unresolved, unaudited, opaque or unproved-total definition and zero absurd.

Named groups pin_at_start, publish_changes_no_running_run, explicit_change_only, settings_affect_next_run, source_set_closed and total_and_redacted (more than 40 inputs, redacted sentinel, equal inputs equal results), the Cure law/audit and the checked example pass; letting a published input change the version makes publish_keeps_version, publish_changes_no_running_run and explicit_change_only fail, and letting an add_source input add a member makes source_set_is_fixed and source_set_closed fail (negative controls). Finite scenarios.
Pinned Cure compilation, reduction checking and BEAM decision semantics; compiler soundness not locally proved.
Pinned Elixir immutable maps, lists and binaries; ready workflow/tool-registry snapshot/1 is reused unchanged as the one check of the source list.

The host builds the source list truthfully at Run start from the pinned recipe and the tenant settings, keeps the pin in the durable state of the Run, asks {:listing, id} before it takes a new tool listing of a source, starts a model graph or a tool only from a known source, and gives {:change_version, _} only on an authorised, recorded action with an identity that state/recipe-store holds as checked.

telemetry.contract: Pure functions emit no observations and no logs; the host owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Intrinsic operands and fixed bounds (identity 89 bytes, the bounds of workflow/tool-registry snapshot/1); no ambient settings.

control.contract: No process or lifecycle; the change-version input is a data operand that the host gives under its own authorisation.
